title: mayso namma horizon fanat
intro: qibaadah miracsentih aydaadu, inki muuci nammayak inkih caylale mirac kee Yallih rammitle taama abeena akkuk soola. Tama num ardi bagul kaxxaam xer dariifa fan gexeeh, ayroytal tan ummattah amol culteh tan data murky spring fanah culteh tan. Kaxxam qajabsitah, ta taama abeynit kaxxa umaaneh agattiinah qaadik tan adaf xisaanamih taamal sugte. Atu tama aydaadul yan num Qur'aanak baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu ardi bagul cayla kee diihay yoh yeceeh suge Kaxxa Racmattale
Anu ayro elle tawqe arac kee elle cultah tan arac fan safar abe
Anu inki qangara cedam duuda mara gufeh an
Anu birtat xoqoysimak giffole adaf xisuh amriseh suge
Anu namma qaleh fanat yan arac laqlaqinte birta alfeh
Anu malaykatak masugiyyo nabiyay, Yalli kah yeceeh yan naqbitak suge.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
